traits.smithy.api#documentation: Email of the user.

OpenID Connect authentication information that allows a user to authenticate through an external identity provider.
If this field is used, the `email` field must not be set.

Captcha.
Captcha validation code. This is required as an anti-fraud measure.

In case of account creation by email, we can choose to receive a magic_link or an authentication_code by email.
By default a magic_link will be sent.
